recommendation: Leave automatic image improvements OFF for now. The notification is an optional recommendation; no affected-image benefit has been demonstrated. This setting is not necessary for automatic catalog lifecycle synchronization.

supplied_account_evidence.provenance: Parent-reported native readback; not independently inspected in this lane
supplied_account_evidence.image_issues: None reported; no invented affected-product count

documented_facts: The feature is OFF by default and can be enabled separately under Products > Automations > image improvements > View details > toggle > Save.
Google attempts to remove detected text, watermarks, overlays or logos. Successful repair can resolve the associated image disapproval.
Needs attention can identify Improved image quality [image_link]; affected product pages show the original and improved images.
For an unsatisfactory result, Google instructs uploading a new image without the promotional overlay.

benefit_and_risk.benefit: Possible future recovery of promotional-overlay image disapprovals; no current approval, traffic or profit gain demonstrated.
benefit_and_risk.risk: Detection may change content beyond an intended promotional label. Product-detail distortion is a review risk inferred from automated removal, not an observed defect here.
benefit_and_risk.reversibility: The permission toggle is reversible. The documentation does not establish automatic restoration of already replaced images when it is switched OFF.

optional_activation_boundary.authority: The parent's stated owner authorization can support this narrow preventive option; this review does not request another user approval.
optional_activation_boundary.narrower_claim_required: Describe it as optional Google image post-processing, not a guaranteed current repair or fully reversible image transformation.
optional_activation_boundary.before_after: Root must bind the exact Merchant account and image-only OFF→ON readback, preserving price, availability, condition and all other controls.
optional_activation_boundary.preservation: Do not edit Shopify images, feed image URLs, original files, Product Studio, paid options, Customer Reviews or customer data.
optional_activation_boundary.verification: If images are changed, compare the Google original and improved product image for faithful garment detail and recheck the affected image issue.
optional_activation_boundary.rollback: Set the image toggle OFF to withdraw permission. Any unsatisfactory processed image needs the documented clean-image replacement path and separate exact source ownership/readback.

next_action: Keep the setting OFF and continue correcting demonstrated catalog or destination issues; reconsider after a current affected-image record establishes a useful repair.

source.title: Allow Merchant Center to improve your product images
